ticket.summary: Leaking cold-water braided supply hose under bathroom sink; customer closed fixture shutoff so leak is contained, but it's the unit's only full bathroom and is now out of service - booked first priority slot 9/1 8:00 AM.
mitigation_advice: Confirmed customer already closed the fixture supply shutoff valve under the sink; advised leaving it closed until the tech arrives [PB-01]
Advised texting back for on-call paging if the leak resumes with the valve shut [PB-01]

quote_lines.description: Supply line replacement - cold-water braided hose under bathroom sink (parts included)

ticket.customer_message: You're all set! Booked: Mon Sept 1, 8:00 AM at 12 Foundry Row, Unit B. Job: cold-water braided supply line replacement, $129 flat rate (about 45 min). If the tech recommends doing the hot line too, they'll quote that second line on-site before touching anything - your call. Until then, just leave that shutoff valve closed [PB-01]; the rest of the home's water is unaffected. If it starts leaking again even with the valve shut, text us back right away and we'll page the on-call plumber.
